overview: This 213-page file combines 1947 correspondence on Japanese bank assets and proposed American banking facilities with Bank of Japan monthly statistics from July–November 1946 and January 1947. The tables document banking, savings, insurance, securities, prices, public debt, and corporate capital during the postwar occupation.
interest: Monthly financial data alongside occupation correspondence connects Japan’s economic conditions with decisions about foreign banking and overseas assets.
